publisher: Maddison Project, Groningen Growth and Development Centre (University of Groningen)
title: Maddison Project Database 2023 (Bolt and van Zanden, 2024)
method: Historical GDP per capita in 2011 international dollars (PPP), compiled from national accounts and academic reconstructions. India before 1947: Broadberry, Custodis and Gupta (2015) for 1600-1871; Heston (1983) for 1870-1900; Maddison (1985) for 1900-46 (per the file's Sources sheets).
limitations: Long-run estimates carry wide uncertainty before 1950; benchmark years are not annual data. Cite: Bolt, J. and van Zanden, J.L. (2024), Journal of Economic Surveys, doi:10.1111/joes.12618.

publisher: Reserve Bank of India (Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2023-24); original source: Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, Ministry of Home Affairs
title: Table 6: State-wise Literacy Rate (per cent), census years 1951-2011
licence: RBI website content; reuse with attribution to RBI and the original source (no explicit open licence stated in the file)
method: Persons literacy rate from each decennial Census as compiled by RBI. Values copied exactly from the Excel table; cells printed as '-' (not available) skipped. Taken from the 2023-24 edition because the latest (2024-25) edition dropped the literacy table.
limitations: Age base changes: 1951-71 rates relate to population aged 5+, 1981-2011 to aged 7+ (break flagged at first 7+ point). 1951 West Bengal relates to total population incl. 0-4; 1951 Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Manipur based on sample population. 2001 India and Manipur exclude three Senapati sub-divisions. Andhra Pradesh is undivided (no Telangana row); Jammu & Kashmir includes Ladakh. Table does not state the territorial basis for pre-2001 figures, though it gives separate figures for Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand and Uttarakhand back to 1951. Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu are printed separately and were left out.

publisher: Reserve Bank of India (Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25); original source: Sample Registration System Bulletin, Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, Ministry of Home Affairs
title: Table 4: State-wise Infant Mortality Rate (per thousand live births), 2004-2023
licence: RBI website content; reuse with attribution to RBI and the original source (no explicit open licence stated in the file)
method: SRS infant deaths per 1,000 live births, total, as compiled by RBI. Values copied exactly; '.' (not applicable) and '-' (not available) skipped. Dadra & Nagar Haveli values marked '*' (2020-2023, footnote: include Daman & Diu) mapped to DH with the marker stripped.
coverage: 35 states/UTs plus All India; annual 2004-2023; 694 values

publisher: Reserve Bank of India (Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25); original source: SRS Abridged Life Tables, Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, Ministry of Home Affairs
title: Table 7: State-wise Life Expectancy (years at birth), 1993-97 to 2019-23
licence: RBI website content; reuse with attribution to RBI and the original source (no explicit open licence stated in the file)
method: Expectation of life at birth, 'Total' column (persons), five-year moving periods from SRS abridged life tables. Values copied exactly; '-' skipped. Year = end year of the period.
coverage: 22 states plus All India; 27 periods 1993-97 to 2019-23; 527 values
limitations: Only major states are covered (no NE states other than Assam, no UTs other than Delhi). Bihar, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh include Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Uttarakhand till 2009-13 (break flagged at 2010-14). Andhra Pradesh includes Telangana till 2013-17 (break at 2014-18). Jammu & Kashmir includes Ladakh in all periods. Overlapping five-year periods are not independent observations.

publisher: Reserve Bank of India (Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25); original source: National Statistical Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
title: Table 20: Per Capita Net State Domestic Product (Constant Prices, base 2011-12, rupees), 2011-12 to 2024-25
licence: RBI website content; reuse with attribution to RBI and the original source (no explicit open licence stated in the file)
method: Per capita NSDP at constant 2011-12 prices in rupees, by fiscal year, as compiled by RBI from NSO/MoSPI. Values copied exactly; '-' skipped. Year = end year of the fiscal year (2011-12 -> 2012).
limitations: No All-India row in this table (India per capita NNI not included here). Jammu & Kashmir includes Ladakh for 2011-12 to 2018-19 and is UT of J&K only from 2019-20 (break flagged). The table does not flag provisional years, but recent state accounts estimates are routinely revised by MoSPI; several states have no 2024-25 (and Gujarat no 2023-24) figure.
